limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the counter but also made `ready_a` high during reset and allowed input on the first edge after reset, and it suppressed `valid_b` during stalls at count 5, unlike the reference fix.

The testbench required always-high `ready_a` and modeled `valid_b` as a pulse only on the sixth accepted bit, so its reset and gap tests confirmed the rewrite’s assumptions instead of catching the timing changes.
